text: Bitcoin's modest 1.1% gain masks stronger momentum in Ethereum, which is up 2.3% and outpacing the largest altcoins, suggesting conviction beyond just BTC price moves. The Fear & Greed index at 71 and rising 8 points over a week indicates retail and institutional appetite is warming, though Bitcoin's dominance holding steady at 58.4% shows money isn't yet rotating hard into alts. Volume at $95B reflects engaged trading, consistent with a risk-on mood that remains measured rather than euphoric.
